Title: General availability: Enhanced Azure Dashboards experience for pinned Log Analytics parts

Body.Content:
Azure dashboards are a quick and easy way to create a single pane of glass to monitor your Azure estate.

Log Analytics allows pinning of query results and visualizations to an Azure Dashboard for easy monitoring.

See Create and share dashboards of Log Analytics data to learn more.

We have enhanced our pinned parts to Azure Dashbaords experince to offer a richer experince allowing you to achieve more with your pinned dashbaord parts.

To learn more please read this community blog post.
